ghi_chu: data_repo.cigext.get theo co che BAN MAU cho trang network/lan (view network/lanncs, js/chunk-7266f7c8...js, ham getLanNcs). Bai Lab 4 (DNS) + Lab 5 (DHCP).
canh_bao: Gia tri trong 'ban_mau_gui_di' (start 100, limit 150, leasetime 80, dhcp_option 6,8.8.8.8,8.8.8.4) la MAC DINH CUA MA NGUON. KHONG phai cau hinh that.

ban_mau_tham_do_sau_apply.ghi_chu: Ban mau ham checkNetworkStatus dung de do xem mang da len lai chua sau Apply. Do kem de xac nhan: thiet bi CHI tra dung nhung khoa duoc hoi.

ghi_chu_khoa: Cung khoa noi bo 'data_repo.cigext.cay_cau_hinh' voi khung_that_cigext_wan.json. Kho cau hinh GOP SAU hai tep lai thanh MOT cay duy nhat (network.wan/wan6/lan/wan64 + network.lan.ipaddr/netmask + dhcp.lan). Chu y: network.lan co ca 'ifname' (tu ban mau WAN) lan 'ipaddr/netmask' (tu ban mau LAN).
